body:
## Pull request overview

This PR refactors `ROADMAP.md` to be shorter and more execution-focused by condensing completed work into narrative summaries and restructuring near-term priorities around P1–P4 (components, console, DX, docs), while explicitly deferring marketplace/cloud items to a “Future Vision” section.

**Changes:**
- Condensed previously checkbox-heavy milestone sections into summarized “Completed Milestones” narratives.
- Replaced the previous roadmap structure with P1–P4 priority tracks and added a “Success Metrics” table.
- Moved marketplace/cloud/community items into a clearly deferred “Future Vision (Deferred)” section.

The success metrics table references `NEXT_STEPS.md`, but that file is under `apps/console/NEXT_STEPS.md` (no root-level `NEXT_STEPS.md`). Please fix the reference/path so readers can find the source of the "~8" console gaps number.
```suggestion
| **Console Gaps** | ~8 (per [apps/console/NEXT_STEPS.md](./apps/console/NEXT_STEPS.md)) | 0 |
```

Test count is listed as "3,235+" here, but `SPEC_COMPLIANCE_EVALUATION.md` currently states "3185+ tests pass". Please align these numbers (or note they come from different runs/dates) to avoid conflicting status reporting across docs.
```suggestion
| **Test Count** | 3,185+ | 4,000+ |
```

The executive summary says "35 packages", but the repo currently has 37 workspace packages under `packages/*` (e.g., includes `packages/runner` and `packages/vscode-extension`). Please update the number or clarify what is being counted (published packages vs workspace packages).
```suggestion
**Where We Are:** The foundation is solid — 37 workspace packages, 91+ components, 165 test files, 66 Storybook stories, 98% spec compliance, and all 42 builds passing. The @objectstack/spec v3.0.0 migration is complete, and the Console v1.0 production build is optimized and shipping.
```

In the architecture diagram, Layer 2 (`@object-ui/types`) is described as having "Zero dependencies" and "No runtime code", but `packages/types/package.json` includes runtime dependencies (`@objectstack/spec` and `zod`) and exports a `./zod` entry. Consider rewording this to "no React deps" / "primarily types + optional zod schemas" to avoid misleading readers.
```suggestion
│  ❌ No React deps. Primarily types + optional Zod schemas.         │
```

This section says "production hardening (CSP headers, ...)" but the Console currently sets CSP via a `<meta http-equiv="Content-Security-Policy">` tag in `apps/console/index.html`, with a note to serve stricter CSP via server headers. Please adjust wording to reflect the actual implementation (meta tag vs headers).
```suggestion
Bundle optimization (main entry 48.5 KB gzip, 17 granular chunks, 95% reduction from monolithic build), Gzip + Brotli pre-compression, MSW lazy-loading with full exclusion in server mode, bundle analysis tooling, and production hardening (CSP via meta tag with guidance for stricter CSP headers, modulepreload hints, cache documentation, error tracking guide, performance budget CI).
```

The roadmap states "Designer Completion" and "All 4 phases complete", but `DESIGNER_UX_ANALYSIS.md` (also last updated Feb 12, 2026) still describes multiple critical gaps and a phased improvement plan. Please reconcile these docs (either update the UX analysis to reflect completion, or soften/remove the completion claim here).
```suggestion
### Designer Progress

Foundational interaction model delivered across 5 designers (Page, View, DataModel, Process, Report): drag-and-drop positioning, undo/redo with command pattern, confirmation dialogs, edge creation UI, inline editing, full property editors with live preview, canvas pan/zoom with minimap, auto-layout algorithms, copy/paste, multi-select, responsive panels, real-time collaboration integration, live cursors, synchronized undo/redo, and version history. Remaining UX gaps and later-phase improvements are tracked in [DESIGNER_UX_ANALYSIS.md](./DESIGNER_UX_ANALYSIS.md).
```
